mission.title: Orison Relief: Small Fabrication Order
mission.description:
Now then,

After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.

We've attached a blueprint outlining what materials you'll need to create them. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. Either way you will need access to an Item Fabricator to make the propulsors yourself.

Once you're done bring them to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> and one of the team will sort out the rest.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
